content.text: {"headline":"Approve P0 (no action): both queues are predicted at 100% service level for 16:00-18:00 at no extra cost.","why":"The payments spike is tied to the open P1 incident INC-20261001-6607 (card authorisation gateway, debit cards declining). Card_declined calls ran at 7.35x normal from 13:30 to 14:15 and made up about 300 of the roughly 400 extra calls. Even so, with current staffing, payments and general are both predicted at 100% for the 16:00-18:00 disruption window against an 80% target, with 0% abandons. General's recent dip (35-65%) looks like small-queue noise or overflow from payments rather than a separate problem. Volume is only 1.5% over forecast, handle time is under forecast and staffing is on plan. Rest-of-day service level is predicted at 95.8%.","trade_offs":["P1 (outage message 16:00-17:00) and P2 (move 1 agent general to payments 18:00-19:00) also cost nothing and give the same 100% in the window. Neither improves on P0: rest-of-day is 95.3% for P1 and 95.5% for P2.","P3 (outage message, 10% chat deflection, callback 18:00-19:00) is the only plan that lifts rest-of-day, to 96.0% from 95.8%. It costs INR 96 for no gain inside the window.","Moving an agent (P2) would take capacity from general, which is not needed on the current forecast."],"watch":"The incident is still open, so watch card_declined volume on payments. If calls climb again or payments service level drops below 80%, switch on the outage message (P1) or the P3 safety net. Also check payments cover around 18:00."}
